verdict.rationale: A payments and digital-account SaaS with an ERP could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such assistant. The documented MCP server only lets the user's own external assistant (e.g., Cursor) query Asaas docs and the API reference, which is a different story and a developer building block rather than an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to. The 'robô de voz' is an automated notification channel, not an AI assistant.
